scope: fixed binary research model; sequential exact own-state updates, not student efficacy or production API

fixed_assumptions.variables: binary skills; independent priors repeating A=4/5,B=2/5,C=3/5 in the frozen inputs

observation.required: all required current skills must equal1

fixed_assumptions.teaching: given 0→1 rate r, known remains known; no forgetting; r0 no-op/r1 independent new=1
fixed_assumptions.inference: exact Fraction own-state sequential updates; stable min-fill; fused bucket product+sumout
fixed_assumptions.cap: 4096 caps a single actually allocated table, not enumerated union, total stored cells, Fraction bytes, skill count or wall time

structural_work_units.peak_scope_peak_cells: actual allocated table scope/cells; refused requested_cells is separate and was not allocated
structural_work_units.enumeration_peak_scope_cells: maximum enumerated bucket union, not a materialized table
structural_work_units.cellwork: the prototype's factor lookups/table-cell visits/constructed L or T cells, not measured production latency
structural_work_units.stored_cells: sum of ending factor table cells; latent variables and Fraction bit growth are reported separately
structural_work_units.summary: trace and segment peak_allocated/enumeration include both updates and post-event queries; update_cellwork sums event operations only, excluding the one-time prior initialization

removed: per-step event_probability/query probability large Fraction strings
publication_omissions.retained: all 66 case identities, actual attempted events/status/modes, per-case query count and unique requirements, all 99 non-time summaries; complete refused scope/cells and that operation stats; repeated rounds and full runs
publication_omissions.shared_inputs: 同一完整输入事件列表只保存一次sequence_id，case独立保留每次受理status；共享输入不代表相同受理结果。
publication_omissions.chain_comparison: common initial+teaching prefix is summarized separately from deferred-only ladder suffix; full summaries are not same-sequence mode comparisons
publication_omissions.numeric_format: integers and original input Fraction strings; no rounded numbers presented as exact measured results
